```{r Librairies, echo=FALSE,eval=TRUE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
jcbPivot<-function(parDF,parRow,parCol,parVal){
  pt <- PivotTable$new()
pt$addData(parDF)
pt$addColumnDataGroups(parCol,addTotal=TRUE)
pt$addRowDataGroups(parRow,addTotal=TRUE)
pt$defineCalculation(calculationName="MontantE",
                     summariseExpression="sum(MontantE, na.rm=FALSE)",format="%.2f")
return(pt)}

```

```{r Soldes des Comptes Fournisseurs ZENITO devient KLINKENB, echo=FALSE,eval=TRUE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
# ZENITO de vien KLINKENB dans MvtReelFour et HCG_Com1 et on ne prend que <2021F
MvtReelFour<-MvtReelFour[MvtReelFour$AnReel<2021,]
MvtReelFour$Tiers<-ifelse(MvtReelFour$Tiers=="ZENITO","KLINKENB",MvtReelFour$Tiers)
HCG_All_C<-HCG_All
HCG_All_C$Tiers<-ifelse(HCG_All_C$Tiers=="ZENITO","KLINKENB",HCG_All_C$Tiers)
# Autres Corrections
HCG_All_C$Tiers<-ifelse(HCG_All_C$Document=="20.011","MARICHAL",HCG_All_C$Tiers)
HCG_All_C<-HCG_All_C[HCG_All_C$Tiers!="zNoTiers",]


MvtReelFourbyT<-aggregate(MvtReelFour$MontantE, by=list(Tiers=MvtReelFour$Tiers), FUN=sum)
HCG_All_C_byT<-aggregate(HCG_All_C$MontantE, by=list(Tiers=HCG_All_C$Tiers), FUN=sum)

#HCG_All_byT$AnReel<-as.character((HCG_All_byT$AnReel))
#HCG_AllbyYbyAxx$Code<-substr(HCG_AllbyYbyAxx$Code,1,3)
SoldeFour<-left_join(HCG_All_C_byT, MvtReelFourbyT, by = c("Tiers"))
SoldeFour$x.x[is.na(SoldeFour$x.x)] <- 0
SoldeFour$x.y[is.na(SoldeFour$x.y)] <- 0
SoldeFour$Solde<--SoldeFour$x.x+SoldeFour$x.y

pt<-PivotTable$new()
pt$addData(SoldeFour)
#ptSF$addColumnDataGroups("AnReel",addTotal=TRUE)
pt$addRowDataGroups("Tiers")

pt$defineCalculation(calculationName="Solde",
                     summariseExpression="sum(Solde, na.rm=FALSE)",format="%.2f")
ptSF<-pt$renderPivot()
```

          On constate que la valve livrée par Marichal est marquée avec Tiers égal à DIVERS dans HCG,<br>on remplace par MARICHAL.<br> <br>
          zNoTiers correspond à un montant qui sera récupéré via la cloture, donc invisible dans MvtReel, on les a supprimés.<br> <br>

```{r Compare with SCF, echo=FALSE,eval=TRUE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
SS<-left_join(SoldeFour, SCF_2020, by = c("Tiers"))
 SST<-SS[c(1,4,5)]
 SST$MontantE<-ifelse(is.na(SST$MontantE),0,SST$MontantE)
 KS<-SST %>%mutate( MontantE=cell_spec(SST$MontantE, "html", color = ifelse(SST$MontantE > 0, "red", "blue"), background = ifelse(SST$MontantE > 0, "yellow", ""))) %>%
mutate( Solde=cell_spec(round(SST$Solde, digits = 3), "html", color = ifelse(SST$Solde > 0, "red", "blue"), background = ifelse(SST$Solde > 0,"yellow", "")))%>%
mutate( Tiers=cell_spec(SST$Tiers, "html", color = ifelse(abs(SST$Solde-SST$MontantE)>0.02, "red", "blue"), background = ifelse(abs(SST$Solde-SST$MontantE)>0.02,"yellow", "")))%>%
   
  kable(format = "html", escape = F) %>%
    kable_styling("striped", full_width = F,position = "float_right") %>% returnValue()
```

```{r Evolution du Solde Belfius, echo=FALSE,eval=TRUE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

# add running sum
Soldes<-aggregate(MvtReelSolde$MontantE, by=list(DateVal=MvtReelSolde$DateVal), FUN=sum)
Soldes<-Soldes%>%mutate(CumSoldes=cumsum(x))
Soldes<-  Soldes[-c(Soldes$DateVal<as.Date("2018/09/01")),]
  #a<-nrow(DF)
  #b<-a-Ndays
  #Last14<-DF[b:a,]
  PTres<-ggplot() + 
    geom_line(data = Soldes, aes(DateVal, CumSoldes, color = "Solde"), size = .5) +
```

```{r Factures, echo=FALSE,eval=TRUE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
HCC_All$Debit<-as.numeric(gsub(",",".",HCC_All$Debit))
HCC_All$Credit<-as.numeric(gsub(",",".",HCC_All$Credit))
Bal_HCC<-aggregate(cbind(Debit,Credit,MontantE) ~ AnReel+Pro, data = HCC_All, FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE)
# Solde Avant Cloture
SoldeAvantCloture<-HCC_All[str_detect(HCC_All$Commentaire,"clo", negate = TRUE),]
SAC_All<-aggregate(cbind(Debit,Credit,MontantE) ~ AnReel+Pro, data =SoldeAvantCloture, FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE)

                  


# SAC_All ne reprend que les appels et les versements, il faut ajouter les soldes de la période antérieure
SPA_All2<-aggregate(SPA_All$MontantE, by=list(AnReel=as.numeric(SPA_All$AnReel),Pro=SPA_All$Pro), FUN=sum)
SAC_All2<-left_join(SAC_All,SPA_All2,by=c("AnReel","Pro")) 
SAC_All2$SAC<--SAC_All2$MontantE-SAC_All2$x
# Frais Commun par An
HCG_Com1AparAn<-aggregate(HCG_Com1$MontantE, by=list(AnReel=HCG_Com1$AnReel), FUN=sum)
Step1<-left_join(SAC_All2,Prov_Tot,by=c("AnReel")) # on ajoute les provision golbale
names(Step1)[3]<-"SAC"
# On calcule les quotités par Pro
QuotparProparAn<-aggregate(Quot_All$Quot,by=list(AnReel=as.numeric(Quot_All$AnReel),Pro=Quot_All$Pro), FUN=sum)
# on accole les Quotités"
Step2<-left_join(Step1,QuotparProparAn,by=c("AnReel","Pro"))
names(Step2)[5]<-"Quot"
Step2$Quot<-ifelse(is.na(Step2$Quot),0,Step2$Quot)
# on ajoute les frais communs globaux
Step3<-left_join(Step2,HCG_Com1AparAn,by=c("AnReel"))
# on répartit les frais communs
Step3$MTAP<-round(-Step3$x*Step2$Quot/1000,digits=2)
# on répartit les provisions
Step3$PCR<-round(Step3$Prov*Step2$Quot/1000,digits=2)
# on calcule le SeCReMA
Step3$SeCReMA<-Step3$PCR-Step3$MTAP
Step3$MTF<--Step3$PCR+Step3$MTAP
# on calcule le Solde avant cloture
Step3$STaP<-Step3$MTF+Step3$SAC
Step3<-subset(Step3, select=-c(x))
Step3Table<-Step3%>%kable(format = "html", escape = F) %>%
kable_styling("striped", full_width = F,position = "float_left",font_size = 10) %>% returnValue


Fact_All<-Quot_All%>% group_by(Pro,AnReel) %>%

  summarise(MTAP = sum(MTAP),PCR = sum(PCR),MTF=sum(MTF),STaP = sum(STaP),SAC = sum(SAC),)





FactTable<-Fact_All%>%kable(format = "html", escape = F) %>%
kable_styling("striped", full_width = F,position = "float_left",font_size = 10) %>% returnValue

Compa_All<-left_join(Step3,Fact_All,by=c("AnReel","Pro"))
CompaTable<-Compa_All%>%kable(format = "html", escape = F) %>%
kable_styling("striped", full_width = F,position = "float_left",font_size = 10) %>% returnValue

#a<-summary(comparedf(Step3, Fact_All,by=c("AnReel","Pro")))
```
